native_drc_lvs_lef.scope: Compact four-PMOS voltage-controlled VCO v4 physical connectivity and main-rule screen only; no post-layout oscillation/PLL/fanout acceptance.

generator.scope: Compact four-PMOS VCO v4 candidate, explicit SUB and NWell taps, external VCTRL and 2.3 V rail. No PLL/clock recovery, post-layout oscillation/fanout/current/RF qualification or complete PHY.

first_pilot.cause: PMOS drain escape loop overwrote the row lane, so gate shared next-row source. Negative-offset upper-metal stub left a 5nm M4 gap. Distinct pin_lane and min/max stub bounds repair actual geometry.

first_checker.cause: Strict native port mode reports mismatch and VCTRL export is absent although internal circuit mapping is Match. Final reader requires exact missing VCTRL plus all62 device geometry; all other faults require actual NoMatch.

scope: Native geometry of exact four-W8 PMOS VCOv4. Real well/body polygons with12 finite ptaps and one finite ntap. No artificial net union, foldedW32, ideal power boost or change to source circuit. Coupled wireRC and powered behavior of this compact macro remain unmeasured. Not yet bank/main-chip integrated.
